name: claude_p10_sort_merge (B09 in-container sort with unit merge; NOT RUN; needs the observation requests in _requests)
classification: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT; REQUIRES NEW READ-ONLY OBSERVATIONS (expectContainerCells, expectNpcBag, expectB09Outcomes) AND A TEST-ONLY GATE HOOK; no step below asserts a log line
_requests: expectContainerCells {x,y,z,cells:[{slot,item,count}|{slot,empty:true}...],unitTotals:{item:count}} : read-only GET /container?x&y&z over StaticContainerResourceSource.Slots (+ ItemValue payload via RebirthNativeItemCodec.Encode for a payload hash field) without opening the UI
expectNpcBag {npc:class,usedSlots:0} : read-only, source EntityRebirthHumanoidNPC.bag.ItemGrid (extend /npcgear bag list with slot/item/count)

expectB09Outcomes {npc:class,count:N,stableCompletion:true} : read-only, source RebirthNpcWorkOutcomeService records with DefinitionId rebirth.work.storage-organization-one; fields OutcomeId, CompletedUtcTicks, DurableWitness prefix named-storage-move:; stableCompletion = RebirthNpcB09CompletionStamp.TryRead(npc, OutcomeId) equals CompletedUtcTicks
b09policy set/get : console or /b09policy over RebirthNpcB09PolicyStore.TryWrite/TryRead (container list, Sort=ByName, Merge=1, SortWithinContainers=1, enabled)
b09gates sort|merge on|off : console hook that sets RebirthNpcB09GateOverride.SortOpen/MergeOpen for this run only (default closed, not persisted)
b09dispatch : console over RebirthNpcB09OrganizationDriver.TryDispatchSaved using a live NPC interaction session; returns the planned step and result

fillcontainer {x,y,z,cells:[{slot,item,count}]} : test-only fixture command (disposable CodexTest) writing exact stacks into a named owned container; existing fixtures can only drag from the backpack through the UI

steps._note: Fixture: an owned, hired, idle human NPC within 20 m of a NAMED owned container C (3 usable cells, nothing else claimed). C cells = [resourceWood x2 (B), resourceStone x1 (A)... use any two stackable items where the sort order puts A before B, e.g. A=resourceClayLump order by localized name]. Arrangement [B x2, A x1, empty].

steps.console: b09policy set npc=$NPC container=20,45,995 sort=ByName merge=1 sortWithin=1 enabled=1 confirm=CodexTest

steps._note: Expected 5 unit moves (see P10_B09 doc Update 9, trace 1): 0->2 P, 0->2 M, 1->0 P, 2->1 P, 2->1 M. Dispatch one at a time and wait for the worker's saved completion; each dispatch is one assignment.
TARGET [A x1, B x2, empty]; per-payload unit totals unchanged; no unit in the NPC bag; five completed outcomes each with a stable completion time; a further dispatch reports nothing to do.
Negative case: with sort/merge gates OFF the same dispatch must create no assignment and leave the container unchanged.
